blocks.text: Clinical Skills learnt - wound dressing ANTT = aseptic non-touch technique explain procedure + consent check pain first clean trolley from clean to dirty gather dressing pack, saline, gauze, waste bag do not touch key parts document wound appearance + exudate + size
Simple dressing change Hand hygiene Prepare equipment PPE Remove old dressing Assess wound Clean from centre outward if advised Apply new dressing Dispose waste Document + patient comfort
Watch for signs of infection • redness • heat • swelling • odour
Need to get quicker without breaking sterility.

gibbs.EVALUATION: Need to get quicker without breaking sterility.
